name: wake-skills
description: Wake's personal skill collection: article evaluation and README writing skills for ZCode.

description_i18n.en: Wake's personal skill collection: article evaluation and README writing skills for ZCode.
description_i18n.zh-CN: Wake 的个人技能合集：文章价值评估与 README 撰写技能。

plugins.name: article-valuator
plugins.description: Evaluate whether an article is worth reading: fetches the page (or takes pasted text), scores depth, actionability, novelty and relevance, then returns a 10-point verdict with evidence.

description_i18n.en: Evaluate whether an article is worth reading: fetches the page (or takes pasted text), scores depth, actionability, novelty and relevance, then returns a 10-point verdict with evidence.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 评估文章值不值得读：抓取链接正文（或分析粘贴文本），按深度、可操作性、新颖度、相关性四维打分，给出 10 分制结论与理由。

plugins.name: readme-craft
plugins.description: Generate a standardized, human-sounding, GFM-compliant README.md, using AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md as extra context when present. Auto-generates a matching SVG banner for the top of the README whenever the environment can produce images (hand-written SVG always works).

description_i18n.en: Generate a standardized, human-sounding, GFM-compliant README.md, using AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md as extra context when present. Auto-generates a matching SVG banner for the top of the README whenever the environment can produce images (hand-written SVG always works).
description_i18n.zh-CN: 生成标准化、语气人性化、符合 GFM 规范的 README.md，可读取 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 作为补充上下文。环境具备生图条件时（手写 SVG 永远可行），自动生成配套的 README 顶部 SVG banner。

plugins.name: readme-banner
plugins.description: Generate GitHub README header banner. Two paths: let an LLM write clean SVG directly (preferred, small and editable), or use image AI (Midjourney / DALL-E / SDXL) and vectorize the output. Also supports running both and comparing 3 candidates from each.

description_i18n.en: Generate GitHub README header banner. Two paths: let an LLM write clean SVG directly (preferred, small and editable), or use image AI (Midjourney / DALL-E / SDXL) and vectorize the output. Also supports running both and comparing 3 candidates from each.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 为 GitHub README 生成顶部 banner / hero 图，支持两种路径：LLM 直接写干净 SVG 代码（首选，轻量可编辑），或用图像 AI（Midjourney / DALL-E / SDXL）出位图再矢量化。同时支持两种都跑、各 3 张候选对比。

plugins.name: changelog-craft
plugins.description: Maintain a Keep a Changelog 1.1.0-compliant, human-sounding CHANGELOG.md. Per-commit mode checks whether a change deserves an entry (appended to Unreleased and committed together); release mode consolidates Unreleased into a version section, backfilling from git log.

description_i18n.en: Maintain a Keep a Changelog 1.1.0-compliant, human-sounding CHANGELOG.md. Per-commit mode checks whether a change deserves an entry (appended to Unreleased and committed together); release mode consolidates Unreleased into a version section, backfilling from git log.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 维护符合 Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 规范、说人话的 CHANGELOG.md。逐笔模式在提交时判定改动是否值得写一条（追加进 Unreleased 并随本次提交），成段模式在发版时把 Unreleased 归段成新版本并对照 git log 补漏。
